blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Seven members of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) were wounded in clashes with an armed group in Sultan sa Barongis, Maguindanao del Sur, that forced more than 3,000 residents to flee their homes, police said Saturday. Police Major Guiseppe Tamayo, spokesperson for the Maguindanao del Sur Police Provincial Office, said the wounded MILF fighters belonged to the groups led by Commanders JP Felmin and Mamo of the MILF’s 106th Base Command. “Fighting has died down but the affected civilians are still in evacuation centers and others are staying with their relatives,” Tamayo told the Inquirer in a […]...
